A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VIBE research work. All 20 pages, including figures, tables, equations, references, and Appendices A–I, support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v3 reports original user-study results from 243 participants across three datasets in Section 5 and Table 1, plus model ablations and correlation analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original 243-participant user study, Table 1 outcomes, Appendix B model ablations, and Appendix G correlation analyses.

M1.justification: Both versions use identical masked-inference grounding and utility scores and weighted candidate selection in Equations (3)–(5). No algorithm, component, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate LearningPaper24 paper-area classification and LongVideoBench/SUTD-TrafficQA video question answering. Dataset coverage, represented domains, and task requirements are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Video Only and Naive comparisons. Figure 3 retains Naive VLM and the LearningPaper24 OpenReview TL;DR/abstract comparisons; appendix CoT participation is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The between-subjects design, participant allocations, stimuli, five candidate summaries, and accuracy/response-time/IES metrics are identical. Appendix D retains the same sampling, masking, and frame-selection settings.

E4.justification: Appendix A's qualitative example, Appendix B's three-model ablation, and Appendix G's correlation analyses are unchanged. Figure 6(a) receives only axis-notation corrections.

E5.justification: Both retain Table 1's means and standard deviations, Figure 4's standard errors, independent t-tests with Cohen's d, and Spearman correlation reporting. No statistical procedure or repeated-run information changes.

E6.justification: Numerical tables, plotted points, trends, and qualitative outputs are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports LearningPaper24 Max-U accuracy of 37.89 ± 10.04% in both. The figure edits concern axis notation.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), masking-independence assumptions, and Appendix I's derivation are identical. The corrected plotting labels do not revise the mathematical definitions or reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions, and conclusion retain the same annotation-free, training-free summary-selection claims and claimed human accuracy and response-time benefits.

C2.justification: Both retain the same grounding–utility trade-off interpretations, long- versus short-video findings, correlation explanations, task-label requirement, and masking/model-bias limitations.

D1.justification: Dataset curation, masking hyperparameters, sampling instructions, study details, and Appendix H's GPU/vLLM configuration are identical. Code and dataset access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, research-positioning passages, and all 48 references are unchanged. No cited work or relationship to prior research is added or revised.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v3 dated 22 September 2025 to v4 dated 13 July 2026. Prose, headings, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3(a–c) and Figure 6(a) change grounding-axis labels from log I(Y; T) to log I(V; T), and utility-axis labels from log I(V; T) to log I(Y; T). Plot content and layout are unchanged. Figure 6(b–c) retains the reversed labels.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects swapped variable pairs in Figure 3 and Figure 6(a), aligning those axes with Section 4's score definitions and reducing reader confusion. This is a limited presentation improvement: Figure 6(b–c) remains mislabeled, while the scientific content and evidence are unchanged.
